alt: 廚師、園丁、維修員、護理師、木工、畫家與辦公工作者在社區市集圍桌交流，各自帶著代表工作的物品。
scene_prompt: 採『社會上各種行業或各色人物』義。現代社區市集裡，廚師、園丁、單車維修員、護理師、木工、畫家與辦公工作者圍桌交流，各自以湯匙、盆栽、扳手、素色提袋、木製模型、空白畫冊與闔上的筆電表現職業。無文字與品牌。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue and warm earthy browns.
